description: This file defines the MockHandler class in the GuzzleHttp library, which provides a way to mock HTTP responses or throw exceptions from a queue for testing purposes. It includes methods for creating mock responses, managing the queue, and handling request invocation.

classes.name: MockHandler
classes.description: A handler class that returns queued responses or throws exceptions, used for testing HTTP clients by mocking server responses.

methods.name: createWithMiddleware
methods.description: Creates a HandlerStack with a MockHandler instance and optional middleware callbacks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the response queue and optional callbacks.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles an incoming request, returning a mocked response or throwing an exception, and manages on_headers events.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds responses, exceptions, callables, or promises to the queue.

methods.name: getLastRequest
methods.description: Returns the last HTTP request received.

methods.name: getLastOptions
methods.description: Returns the options of the last request.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of remaining queued responses.

methods.name: invokeStats
methods.description: Invokes the on_stats callback with transfer statistics.
